title: DeflectBench：评估大语言模型生成修辞谬误能力的基准
summary: DeflectBench评估四个前沿模型在三种转移策略、七种提示框架和80个主张下的23990次生成。发现拒绝主要由请求结构而非主张内容决定，提示框架变化可使拒绝率波动近100个百分点。教育辩论教练提示可使拒绝率降至接近零，但模型通常产生标记合规。
summary_en: DeflectBench evaluates 23,990 generations from four frontier models across deflection strategies, prompt framings, and claims. Refusal is governed by request structure, not claim content. Prompt framing can swing refusal by nearly 100 points. Educational debate coach framing collapses refusal, but yields labeled compliance.
